# NestedPositiveIfStatements

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `NestedPositiveIfStatementsInspection`

An `if` that is the only statement inside another `if` (without alternative
branches) can be merged into its parent with `&&`; an `if` that is the only
statement inside an `else` block can become `else if`. Both remove a nesting
level.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,11,17,21,45} [Before]
<?php
function merge_cases($u, $v, $w) {
    if ($u) {
        if ($v) {
            go();
        }
    }

    if ($u && $v) {
        // explain
        if ($w > 2) {
            run();
        }
    }

    if ($u ?? $v) {
        if ($w) { run(); }
    }

    if ($u) {
        if ($v) { run(); } else { stop(); }
    } else { stop(); }

    if ($u) {
        if ($v) {}
    } else {
        stop();
    }

    if ($u || $v) {
        if ($w) {}
    }

    if ($u) {
        if ($v) {}
        else { stop(); }
    }
}

function else_cases($u, $v) {
    if ($u) {
        run();
    } else {
        // fallback
        if ($v) {
            stop();
        } else {
            halt();
        }
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function merge_cases($u, $v, $w) {
    if ($u && $v) {
            go();
        }

    if ($u && $v && $w > 2) {
        // explain
            run();
        }

    if (($u ?? $v) && $w) { run(); }

    if ($u && $v) { run(); } else { stop(); }

    if ($u) {
        if ($v) {}
    } else {
        stop();
    }

    if ($u || $v) {
        if ($w) {}
    }

    if ($u) {
        if ($v) {}
        else { stop(); }
    }
}

function else_cases($u, $v) {
    if ($u) {
        run();
    } else if ($v) {
        // fallback
            stop();
        } else {
            halt();
        }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Merge this if statement into its parent construct.</li>
<li>line 11: Merge this if statement into its parent construct.</li>
<li>line 17: Merge this if statement into its parent construct.</li>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "NestedPositiveIfStatements": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore NestedPositiveIfStatements

/**
 * @noinspection NestedPositiveIfStatementsInspection
 */
```
